signals.summary: Owner-made enrichment for pets — cardboard cat chairs, 'cat TV', homemade perches — object-led posts where the build, not the animal's face, carries the image.
signals.why_now: A small but clean object-led thread on r/cats: 'I made an ergonomic cat chair with paper cardboard' (24.9h) and 'Cat TV ruined my cat' (1h). Object-and-scene led, which sidesteps the category's synthetic-animal-consistency problem.
